scope: Fixed original113 natural120 and pressure60; reused unchanged for joint_path, claim_repeat, and single_token pilot screens
quality_signal: total correct gain >=4, natural MCC gain >=0.015
risk_signal: total false-S reduction >=2, total correct delta >=-2, natural MCC delta >=-0.01
borderline: Record weak directions honestly; near-baseline changes without risk gain do not justify three full forwards per case
larger_development_goal: about +0.02 MCC without material PA/risk harm, or about20% false-S reduction with limited MCC/PA cost; no obvious class failure
